name: Muramite Citadel: Ritual Chamber
summary: A Discord‑charged ritual hall where Muramite Inquisitors conduct arcane rites to empower the Citadel.
description: The Ritual Chamber is the ceremonial heart of Muramite arcane practice. Discord runes pulse across the floor, ritual circles glow with unstable energy, and Inquisitors channel raw Discord power into weapons, wards, and arcane constructs. Dragorn captives are sacrificed or used as conduits, while Discord manifestations drift between ritual anchors. The chamber is volatile, dangerous, and saturated with arcane resonance.
